title: Female pelvis & perineum anatomy
description: The female pelvic floor in sagittal section: bladder and urethra, vagina and anteverted uterus, rectum behind — plus the ligaments and pouches that position them.

questions.question: Which organs are located in the female pelvis?
questions.answer: The female pelvis contains bladder, uterus, cervix, vagina and rectum, with ovaries and uterine tubes toward the lateral pelvic regions.

questions.question: What supports the uterus and pelvic organs?
questions.answer: Pelvic-floor muscles and connective-tissue attachments provide key support. The broad ligament is a peritoneal fold, not the sole load-bearing support.

questions.question: Where is the urinary bladder in the female pelvis?
questions.answer: Reservoir behind the pubic symphysis. Function: Stores urine.

questions.question: Where is the vagina located?
questions.answer: Muscular canal from cervix to vestibule. Function: Intercourse, menstrual flow, birth canal.

questions.question: What is the function of the vesico- & recto-uterine pouches?
questions.answer: Function: Allow organ movement; collect free fluid. Peritoneal recesses front and back of uterus.
